tei:div.tei:p: ('a)༄༅// khyab bdag 'khor los bsgyur rgyal ma bzhugs so// swasti/ khyab bdag 'khor los bsgyur rgyal la// phyag 'tshal gsang sngags sgrub pa'i rten// gong du bshad pa spyir btang gi /dmigs bsal phye nas bshad par bya// gsang sngags bla na med pa yi// lam rten thun mong ma yin pa// theg pa mchog gi sems bskyed dang*// gang zag bdag tu ma rmongs pa'i// shes rab dang ni chos thams cad// rang rang ngo bos stong par ni// bsgrub pa'i rigs pa sngon 'gro bas// khyad par nyid du byas yin gyi// rim pa gnyis po tsam zhig ni// phyi rol pa dang nyan thos dang*// rang sangs rgyas la'ang bkag pa med// lha chen po dang khyab 'jug dang*// tshangs pas bstan pa'i gsang sngags kyi// rjes 'brang mu stegs rjes bzung phyir// rgyal bas rgyud sde so sor gsungs// rgyud gang de de'i chos skor du// rjes gzung bya de'i lam med na// de yis de dag rjes 'dzin par// nus pa'i shes byed gang du btsal// de tshe brten gyi gang zag ni// 'jig rten pa dang thun mong bar// phung po btags pa'i nga tsam de// grub mthar rtag gcig rang dbang can// de nyid lhag gang der goms pas// de de gsal bar snang ba ni// zad par sa sogs ji bzhin pa// rnal 'byor can las gzhan la yang*// goms pa po ltar snang ba'i dpe// sgyu ma'i glang po la sogs gzhan// rnal 'byor de yis khams gnyis las// 'phags par nus mod gang zag gi /bdag tu rmongs phyir khams gsum las// 'da' bar nus pa ma yin no// gzung 'dzin rgyu ba khegs pa na// dbu mar 'dus pa las byung ba'i// lhan skyes 'dzin med ngang nyid du// 'jog par nus pa'ang srid mod kyi// de 'drar shes rig skyes bur ni// zhen pa'i rtog pas bcings phyir na// khams gsum pa las 'da' mi nus// nyan thos dge slong sngags kyi rten// mchog tu dus 'khor las gsungs phyir// bla med rgyud du gsungs pa yi// rim gnyis rten du rung bar brtag

/rten yang bdag ces bya ba yi// gzung 'dzin dang bral ye shes nyid// yin phyir lam des tshe de la// dgra bcom mngon du byed par nus// chos bdag med la ma goms shing*// theg chen sems bskyed dang bral bas// rten de nyid la rdo rje 'dzin// mngon du byed par nus ma yin// bgrang dang rjes 'gro 'jog pa sogs// nyan thos gzhung du gang bshad pa'i// rlung gi rnal 'byor mthar phyin tshe// de der 'dzin pa kun bral yang*// chos su rmongs pa ma log dang*// log kyang goms par ma byas phyir// shes bya'i sgrib kun stong mi nus// rang sangs rgyas kyi srid tha ma// gsang sngags thos pa'i rten min yang*// tshe rabs gzhan la nyan thos dang*// 'dra bar bzhag nus ma yin na// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la bkod pa'i// rang sangs rgyas rnams don med 'gyur// rang sangs rgyas kyi tshul bstan pa// yin zhes zer mod de der ni// tshul bstan pa las de'i rigs can// gsang sngags rten du rung bar mtshon// lha chen po dang tshangs pa sogs// de tshul bzung yang sangs rgyas dngos// yin par bshad dang rang rgyud par// 'chad pa'i tshul gnyis byung ba yang*// de dang mtshungs te bsgrub tshul la// bstod nas sangs rgyas su bsgrub dang*// smad nas rang rgyud par bzhag pa// lha chen tshul bzung sangs rgyas nyid// yod na drag po rang rgyud pa// gsang sngags rten du ci mi rung*// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// shu bhaṃ// // ༄// swasti/ khyab bdag 'khor los bsgyur rgyal la// phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar// spyod pas mtshams sbyor med mi rung*// yin par gsungs pa'i dgongs bshad bya// mi yi rten can las dang po// tshe gcig nyid la de byed pa'i// thabs su de dgos par 'chad kyi// rnam pa kun du der mi bzhed// bzhed na rdo rje theg pa yis// rdzogs sangs rgya ba'i lam gyi rten// 'dod pa'i khams dang mi yi rten// kho nar nges pa nyid du 'gyur// 'dod na phar phyin theg pa yi// rdzogs sangs rgya ba'i rten kun yang*// de der nges pa nyid 'gyur te// sngags la ma brten de med par// khyed kyi khas blangs nyid phyir ro// sa bcu rgyun gyi mtha' ma yi// bar chad med lam sngon song nas// sngags la brten nas sangs rgya bar// khas len byed pa de tshe'ang*// mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen gyis// mtshams sbyor byed pa nyid rigs kyi// nye ba'i rgyu gzhan 'dir med de// rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam gyis// ma spangs nyon mongs bag chags ni// 'ga' yang yod pa min phyir ro// de phyir sngags la ma brten par// rdzogs sangs rgya ba yod min zhes// 'chad pa spyir btang du bshad na// khams gsum las ni yang dag par// rab 'das dag pa'i zhing gzhan du// rdzogs sangs rgya ba med 'gyur zhing*// 'og min rten dang rig 'dzin dang*// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas la sogs// 'dod pa'i khams las ma 'das 'gyur// yang dag par na phar phyin gyi// bar chad med lam kun rdzogs nas// sngags kyi nye rgyus mtshams sbyor ba'i// rgyu tshogs grangs tshang ma yin te// nyon mongs bag chags bcas spangs phyir// yang na dag pa'i sa thob pa// zag med yid kyi rang bzhin gyi// lus ma blangs pa mi srid phyir// 'o na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// gnas ma thob pa de srid du// rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du ni// 'tshang mi rgya bar gsungs de ci// zhe na gong du bshad ji bzhin// mi yi rten can las dang po// spyod pa gsum la ma bslabs par// phar phyin theg par gang gsungs pa'i// chos kyi sprin dang ming mthun par// de tsam mngon du byas rjes su// nye rgyus mtshams sbyor dgos pa'i don// yin gyi gzugs khams rten can gyi// sangs rgyas mi bzhed ga la srid// 'o na khyad par ci zhe na// phar phyin sa bcu'i mtha' mar ni// nyon mongs bag chags kun spong zhing*// sngags kyi de mthar de yi spong*// ci phyir zhe na de mthar yang*// sa gnyis nges par bsnon dgos phyir// de yi dgos pa bsam mi khyab// ces pa'i ming can nye rgyu yis// 'tshams sbyor sa gnyis dgos phyir ro// zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa yi// ye shes med par mtshams mi sbyor// bag chags kun spangs ye shes de// mngon du byed pa'i thabs yod min// 'o na sngags kyi sa bcu por// cig shos sa bcu'i yon tan kun// rdzogs pa min par thal zhe na// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs byed pa'i thabs// ma lus de nyid du 'dus kyang*// tshe de nyid la lhan skyes kyi// ye shes mngon du byed pa'i thabs// med mi rung ba 'pho ba yi// bag chags ched du gnyer spong ba// sngags kyi sa bcu pa la med// yod na bcu gnyis sa'i rnam gzhag

/bshad pa ci phyir yin pa soms// dper na byang sems mthong lam du// nyan thos rtogs pa kun rdzogs kyang*// bag la nyal gyi nyon mongs pa// ched du gnyer nas mi spong bzhin// sngags lugs drod chen po thob nas// spyod pas mtshams sbyar mthong lam pa// zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa yi// ye shes mngon du byas zin phyir// sngags kyi sa bcu'i rgyun mtha' nas// bag chags spong la 'gal ba med// de nas mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i// bde chen grangs ni kun tshang ba// sa gnyis po yis rdzogs par bya// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// shu bhaṃ// // ༄// swasti/ sngags kyi sa bcu'i rnam gzhag la// pha rol phyin pa'i sa bcu po'i// ming mthun na yang don mthun dang*// de las gzhan pa gnyis su bshad// don mthun pa ni phan tshun du// yin khyab mnyam par mi bzhed kyi// de'i nang du cig shos kyi// yon tan tshang ba lhag dang bcas// tshang tshul sa rnams tha dad du// bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa dang*// mthong dang bsgom pas spang bya ba// phal cher spong bar nus pa yin// don mi mthun pa pha rol du// phyin pa kho na'i sa bcu dang*// sngags kyi thun mong min pa yi// sa gnyis po'am phyed dang gsum// phar phyin rkyang ba'i sa bcu nas// sngags la 'jug tshul rnam pa bcu// yod kyang sa bcu rgyun mtha' pa// bla med theg par 'jug min te// bsod nams tshogs chen kun rdzogs shing*// nyon mongs rnams ni bag chags dang*// bcas kun spangs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// de yi dngos rgyu nus mthu ni// thogs med tshang ba yin phyir ro// pha rol phyin pa'i rab dga' nas// chos sprin tsam po'i bar dag ni// gang nas sngags la 'jug kyang rung*// sngags kyi sa chen bcu gnyis po// rdzogs par mngon du byed dgos te// de med par yang de yis ni// rdzogs sangs rgyas pa mi 'byung phyir// thun mong min pa'i sa gnyis po// snga ma rnams kyi khyab byed du// ma lus rgyas par song mod kyang*// sngags kyi sa bcu kun rdzogs pa'i// mthar yang mngon du byas dgos te// nye rgyu'i mtshams sbyor dgos phyir ro// sngags kyi sa chen bcu po yi// nang du pha rol phyin pa'i sa// bcu po yar ldan du tshang zhing*// thun mong min pa'i sa gnyis su// rgyun mtha'i bar chad med pa'i sa// yon tan tshul gyis tshang bas na// bcu gcig kun du 'od kyi sa// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa ni// gnyis ka'i 'bras bu'i mthar thug pa// yin pa shing rta'i srol las byung*// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o//

//shu bhaṃ// //swasti/ khyab bdag 'khor los bsgyur rgyal la// phyag 'tshal nas ni gsang sngags kyi// thun mong min pa'i sa rnams la// 'jug tshul rim bzhin bshad par bya// sngags kyi mos spyod sar gnas pa'i// byang sems 'khor lo sdom lta bu// yongs rdzogs rtog pa dang bcas pa'i// bskyed rim mthar son drod gsum po// gang yang rung ba nyid dang ni// rang byin rlabs la gdeng thob nas// spyod pa rnam gsum gang rung zhig /spyod pa'i mthun rkyen tshang gyur tshe// gang du rgyu ba'i yul chen po// spyir btang bcu gnyis su bshad pa// rab dga' la sogs sa bcu dang*// dpe med pa dang ye shes che// zhes bya thun mong min pa yi// sa gnyis po dang rim bzhin du// sbyor bar bzhed la mi mthun med// khyad par sngags kyi sbyor lam pa// spyod pa'i don du rgyu ba'i yul// gnas kyi ming can gsang sngags kyi// sa dang po yi dpa' bo dang*// rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs pa'i yul// gang yin 'khrul med ngos bzung nas// the tshom med pa der zhugs tshe// brda dang brda'i lan sogs la// 'khrul pa med par brtags dpyad de// rang nyid rnal 'byor pha yin na// der yod rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*// rang nyid rnal 'byor ma yin na// der yod rnal 'byor pha rnams dang*// rtog pa'i bye brag tshul bzhin du// shes nas snyoms par 'jug bya ba// de tshe sngags kyi mthong ba'i lam// mngon du 'gyur ba zhes su bshad// de nas bzung ste 'bras bu la// mtshams sbyor mi ran de srid du// chags can ched du mi spong zhing*// nye rgyus las byung zhu bde yi// ye shes mngon du gyur pa las// byung ba'i chags chen ye shes kyi// 'pho ba'i bag chags kun spangs pa// de tshe rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa// mngon du gyur pa zhes bya'o// de bzhin gzhan la'ang sbyar bya ste// dper na sngags kyi sa dang por// bden pa mthong yang las mtha' la// chags pas spyod pa la rgyu ba'i// mthun rkyen tshang bar ma gyur na// spyod pa'i tshul la ma ltos par// sngags kyi sa gzhan 'bad rtsol gyis// bsgrubs nas mthun rkyen tshang ba dang*// bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa gnyis// mnyam du 'dzom par gyur pa'i tshe// nges par spyod pas mtshams sbyar nas// rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon du 'gyur// sngags kyi sa bcu spyod pa la// ltos dang ma ltos gnyis bshad pa// ltos pa shin tu myur mod kyang*// dus ma yin par yang dag mtha'// mngon du byas pa'i nyes dmigs dang*// gnyen po zhan la rtsa ba yi// ltung bas gos pa'i nyes 'byung srid// spyod pa'i tshul la ma sbyangs kyang*// sngags kyi bden pa mthong srid pa// dbang bskur ye shes phebs pa dang*// lus kyi byed pa bcings sogs dang*// byin rlabs rim pa las kyang 'byung*// yul chen nyi shu rtsa bzhir ni// yod pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// mi dang mi ma yin pa'am// lha la sogs pa ci zhe na// khams gsum po las yang dag par// 'das rnams mi sogs lnga dag tu// bsdu bar nus pa ma yin mod// skabs 'dir blang bya'i gtso bo ni// gsang sngags bsgrub pa'i dpa' bo dang*// rnal 'byor ma gang mi'am ni// mkha' la spyod sogs gang yang rung*// bcu gnyis sa'i dbang phyug 'ga'// rang nyid smin cing gzhan grol phyir// bram ze la sogs rigs dag tu// bsam zhing skye ba bzhes rnams so// de dag gang na yod pa'i sar// spyod pa'i mthun rkyen tshang ba rnams// spyod pa'i don du rgyu ba ni// gzhung gi dngos brtan du bshad pa// kho nar ma zad de dag kyang*// mthun rkyen tshang ba'i gsang sngags pa// gang na yod pa der yang 'ong*// de dang lhan cig spyod pa las// de'i rtogs pa gang yin pa'i// sa de sngags pas mngon du byed// lhag pas dman pa grol byed cing*// mnyam pas kyang ni mnyam pa grol// skyes pas bud med grol nus shing*// bud med nyid kyis bud med kyang*// mthar phyin tshe na grol bar bshad// thun mong min pa'i sa gnyis po// sngags kyi sa bcu so so dang*// mnyam por khyab byed du song ba// de tshe sngags kyi sa bcu pa'i// rgyun mthar nye rgyus mtshams sbyar ba// tsam gyis chog par don gyis thob// 'o na bcu gnyis sa yi grangs// nges pa min pa thal zhe na// pha rol phyin pa'i sa bcu yi// don tshang ming yang mthun pa ni// bcu las lhag gyur med pas na// dpe med pa dang ye shes che// thun mong min pa'i sar bshad do// gnyis pa snga ma'i sa rnams su// khyab byed dag tu song tshe yang*// sa bcu po yi bsod nams tshogs// rdzogs par ma byas de srid du// nye rgyus mtshams sbyor mi rung zhing*// mtshams sbyor sa de sa bcu pa'i// rgyun mthar bshad pa nyid kyis chog

/rnal 'byor dbang phyug man ngag las// sngags kyi slob pa'i sa na ni// phyed bcas bcu gsum du bshad nas// bum dbang sa drug gsang dbang gi /sa bzhi gsum pa'i sa gnyis dang*// bzhi pa'i sa phyed du bshad pa// de yi dgongs pa brtag dka' ba// 'di ltar 'chad do sngags pa la// rim gyis ba dang cig char ba'i// ming can gnyis las dang po yis// bum dbang thob nas bskyed pa'i rim// mthar phyin pa la gsang ba'i dbang*// bskur nas rang byin brlab rim la// gdeng thob gyur tshe gsum pa'i dbang*// bskur nas pho nya'i lam goms pa// mthar phyin tshe na nye rgyu yis// mtshams sbyar skad cig gnyis pa la// rdo rje 'dzin sa brnyes par bzhed// de tshe sngags kyi sa drug pa// tshun chad spyod pa'i don du ni// rgyu bar 'chad pa ma yin te// gsang ba'i dbang bskur ma thob cing*// rang byin brlabs pa med phyir ro// sa bcu pa la rang byin brlabs// mthar phyin pas ni spyod pa yi// rgyu tshogs mtha' dag sgrub byed kyi// gsum pa'i dbang bskur med par min// sa drug por ni bskyed rim gyis// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs byed pa'i tshe// nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib// spong byed gnyen po dbang bskur las// thob pa'i lta grub gang yin dang*// nyams su len pa'i gnad gsum gyis// gtan la phab pa'i lta ba'o// de nas rim bzhin dbang bskur ba// gsum las byung ba'i bde chen gyi// ye shes chung 'bring che rnams kyis// spang bya bag chags bcas sbyong zhing*// bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs par byed// gnyis pa skal ldan cig char bas// dbang bskur rnam bzhi dkyus gcig la// rdzogs par mnos nas rim pa gnyis// zhag re bzhin yang spel mar ni// goms pas sa drug yongs rdzogs pa// de tshe las dang po de la// bskyed pa'i rim pa gtso che bas// de skad brjod kyi skabs de na// rdzogs rim sa rnams med ma yin// yod phyir bum dbang sa drug kyang*// spyod pa las thob srid par bzhed// 'o na bskyed rim sa drug dang*// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sa drug po// mthar phyin dus mnyam du thal bas// sa bcu gnyis kyi go rim dang*// grangs nges nyams par thal zhe na// kun la bskyed rim rten du ni// dgos phyir go rim mi nyams shing*// lta spyod rdzas rnams so so bar// yod phyir grangs nges nyams pa med// bskyed pa'i rim las phyi nang gnyis// nang gi bskyed rim mthar phyin pa// de la yul chen nyi shu bzhi'i// dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor mas// byin gyis brlob par byed mod kyi// rang byin brlabs pa'i rim med par// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i spyod pa ni// yod ma yin pa gzhung gi don// zhar la yul chen nyer bzhi dang*// sum cu gnyis dang sum cu bdun// bzhi bcu zhe brgyad zhes bya dang*// grong rdal gcig tu kun tshang ba// sogs kyi rnam gzhag mang na yang*// gang na yod pa'i sa de ni// 'dod pa'i khams yin khams gong ma// gnyis min khams gsum las 'das pa'i// yul du'ang de dag bzhag pa med// sa 'og dmyal ba lta ci smos// klu'i 'jig rten dag dang ni// gshin rje'i 'jig rten de na yang*// yul gang yod ces brtag par bya// skabs 'dir nyer mkho 'dzam gling gi

/yul chen du bshad gang yod dang*// khyad par grong brdal che gcig na'ang*// gsang sngags sa chen bcu gnyis kyi// dbang phyug rnal 'byor pha ma rnams// yod phyir gsang sngags sgrub pa pos// bde chen rnyed par mi dka' zhes// rgyud las gsungs pa de bzung bya// de skad rgyas par bshad 'di ni// pha rol phyin pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// sngags kyi tshogs lam nas bzung ste// bcu gnyis sa la rim bzhin du// zhugs nas rdzogs sangs rgya'o zhes// zer 'ga' legs par bshad nyid du// 'khrul pa spangs pa'i phyir yang ste// khyad par gsang sngags bla med kyi// lam la dga' ba mang mod kyang*// nges pa'i don gyi lam rim la// gdeng thob med kyang blo gzu bo// 'ga' zhig rjes su bzung phyir dang*// rang gis lan brgyar bsam pa las// nges gang rgyud gzhung mtha' dag dang*// mthun nam gzhan zhes brtag bya'i phyir// 'bad pas sbyar ba 'di dge'o// //shu bhaṃ// //swasti// //khyab bdag 'khor los bsgyur rgyal la// phyag 'tshal nas ni phyi rabs pa// sngags la 'jug pa'i sgo 'gegs la// sgo dbyer 'khrul pa de brtag bya// gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs kyis// longs spyod rdzogs sku sgrub byed tshe// ma dag rnam smin phung po 'di// logs su bor nas gzhi lus la// rim pa lnga po'i go rim gyis// sgyu ma lta bu'i sku 'grub zer// gnyug ma gzhi lus zhes bya ba// de'i ngos 'dzin dris pa na// rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i lus// sems can kun la yod yin lo// rlung gi ngos 'dzin las rlung ngam// ye shes rlung yin sems de yang*// tshogs drug 'khor bcas las gzhan pa// khyed la med phyir der 'dod dam// las kyi rlung ni rnam smin gyi// ma dag phung po las gzhan min// dbu mar tshud pa'i ye shes rlung*// sems dang tshogs pa gcig mi 'grub// ci phyir zhe na dbu mar ni// tshud pa'i sems la tshogs drug gi

/dbye ba yod pa min phyir ro// de phyir dbu ma'i rlung ye shes// tshogs pa gcig tu gang gyur pa// de nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// bsgrub pa'i gzhi zhes zer na smos// las rlung dbu mar 'phos pa'i tshe// 'byung dang 'jug pa dang bral yang*// 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan pa// mi 'gal zung 'jug sku ji bzhin// sku gsung thugs dang ye shes kyi// rdo rje rnam bzhi gcig gyur pa// ye shes rlung gis sgyu ma'i sku// dbyibs dang kha dog tshogs bkra ba// rab tu bris pa ltar snang ba// dpa' bo gcig pa'am dkyil 'khor gyi// tshogs rnams kun du gsal bar snang*// 'di ni lus dben bskyed pa'i rim// rtog bcas bsgom pa yongs rdzogs pas// 'khrul med rnal 'byor pa'i mngon sum// de sgrub byed pa'i sbyor ba dang*// dngos gzhi'i dus su kun slong dang*// der zhen rtog pa dang bcas phyir// kun rdzob bden pa zhes bshad mod// bsgrub pa'i gzhi dang grub pa'i 'bras// chos dbyings mngon sum nyid yin phyir// don dam bden pa las ma 'das// 'od gsal ba dang sgyu ma'i sku// bden gnyis so sor 'byed pa'i tshe// sgyu mar zhen pa'i rnam rtog dang*// bral ma bral las so sor 'byed// sgra don 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog kun// bral yang gnyis snang bag chags dang*// ma bral dag pa'i sa rnams su// zung 'jug sku la res 'jog phyir// bslob bzhin pa yi zung 'jug dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas tshe mnyam bzhengs kun// zung 'jug sku las g.yo med phyir// zung 'jug mi slob par bshad do// de phyir longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// bsgrub gzhi sngon 'gro dben gsum dang*// bum pa'i dbang dang gsang ba'i dbang*// med par mi 'byung phyir na de// sems can kun la yod ma yin// yongs rdzogs bskyed rim gsal snang can// de las lhag cing gzhan gyur pa'i// gzugs sku'i rigs 'dra snga ma zhig

/'bad pas btsal ba'i khengs gtam gyis// sa chen 'gengs par ma byas shig /zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// //shu bhaṃ// //swasti// //khyab bdag 'khor los bsgyur rgyal la// phyag 'tshal gsang ba 'dus chos kyi// sgo 'gegs pa la sgo 'byed du// 'khrul tshul gnyis pa'ang brtag bya ba// 'di skad zer te rim pa lngar// bde stong sbyor tshul shes dgos lo// de yi ngos 'dzin dris pa na// bde ba las kyi phyag rgya dang*// sbyar las byung ba'i zhu bde dang*// stong pa dbu ma rigs tshogs su// gsungs las gzhan pas go mi chod// yul can bde bas yul stong nyid// nges pa'i shes pa ma drangs na// bdag tu 'dzin pa gnyis po yi// gnyen por rung ba min zhes zer// bde ba'i ngos 'dzin ma go zhing*// stong pa'i ngos 'dzin 'khrul pa dang*// bde stong sbyor tshul shing rta yi// srol chen rnams dang 'gal bar nges// tha mal lus tshor bde ba dang*// khyad par khyed kyis ma phyed pas// zag pa med pa'i bde ba ni// ngos ma zin pas thog mar 'khrul// stong pa'i ngos 'dzin med dgag nyid// bzung phyir yul can rtog par thal// bde bas stong pa nges pa'i blo// sgra don 'dzin pa'i rtog nyid du// khas blangs phyir na gsang sngags kyi// rnal 'byor mngon sum gang nas btsal// kun rtog bzhon pa'i rlung rnams ni// 'gog pa chos 'dir gtso bo'i phyir// 'od gsal ba dang zung 'jug blo// rtogs par 'dod pa ma 'khrul lam// nges pa 'dren par khas blangs kyi// nges blor 'dod pa min zhe na// gzung 'dzin rlung la zhon pa yi// shes de nges pa min zer dang*// spyi mtshan nges blo rtog med pa// shing rta'i srol chen dag dang 'gal// sgyu ma dang ni 'od gsal gyi// yul can rtog par khas blangs tshe// bden gnyis so sor nges pa'i phyir// zung 'jug rim pa gang du btsal// gzhung dang snga rabs pa dag la// sngon chad grags pa min pa'i gtam// bde stong sbyor tshul shes dgos zhes// zer ba brtags shing dpyad de dge/

//shu bhaṃ// //swasti// //khyab bdag 'khor los bsgyur rgyal la// phyag 'tshal gsang ba 'dus chos kyi// lam 'gegs pa la lam 'byed du// 'khrul snang gsum pa'ang 'dir brtag bya// rdzogs sangs rgyas la kun rdzob kyi// snang ba 'char dang snang ba sems// yin pa 'gog dang rang rig pa// 'gog pa rnam gsum zla grags kyis// gsang 'dus 'chad pa'i lam yin lo// rdzogs sangs rgyas la der snang na// snod kyi 'jig rten ma lus kun// gzhal yas khang par gsal 'debs pa// de tshe dag dang ma dag pa'i// snang ba gnyis po gzhi gcig tu// 'gal med 'char ram sangs rgyas la// dag pa'i snang ba 'char mi 'dod// de mi 'char na brten pa yi// lha tshogs kyang ni der thal bas// rten dang brten par bcas pa yi// bskyed rim don med ma yin nam// bskyed rim dus su sems can yang*// sangs rgyas nyid du snang ba bzhin// rdzogs sangs rgyas la ma dag pa'i// 'jig rten dag par snang zhe na// dag pa snang ba 'ba' zhig par// snang phyir ma dag snang bar 'gal// yang na de min der 'dzin phyir// rdzogs sangs rgyas blo 'khrul par 'gyur// rdzogs sangs rgyas la chos kyi dbyings// 'ba' zhig dag par 'char ba ni// dhar+m+ma dhā tu swa bha wa// at+ma ko haṃ zhes las rtogs// bskyed rim dus kyi snang ba kun// ye shes las grub zer ba dang*// snang ba sems su dngos smra bas// 'dod phyir dor zhes zer ba 'gal// stong pa'i ngang las gang bsgrubs pa'i// sngags kyi kun spyod rgya che ba// gang snang bem po'am shes pa zhes// brtags na snang ba sems dang ni// rang rig mi 'dod bzhin du'ang grub// khyed kyi bde stong sbyor dus su// stong pa'i ngos 'dzin ye shes sam// med par dgag pa las gzhan med// dang po ltar na rang rig tu// grub cing med par dgag yin na// 'od gsal ba ni stong nyid kyi// mthar thug nyid du bshad pas na// med par dgag pa nyid 'gyur phyir// zung 'jug dngos kyi nyer len dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas la blo med 'gyur// 'od gsal ba yi ngos 'dzin ni// stong pa nyid la mi 'chad par// thams cad stong pa dang 'dres pa'i// yul can bde ba cher 'chad na// ngos 'dzin de 'dra 'phags skor gyi// gzhung nas bshad pa'i lung med cing*// rigs pa yang ni gsang sngags kyi// sems dben nas bzung sgyu ma sogs// kun kyang 'od gsal nyid du thal// kho bo cag ni zla grags kyis// dbu mar bshad pa'i stong nyid las// yul can logs su mi 'dod kyi// yul can gang yin stong nyid du// sim nas med par dgag song ba'i// tshe na de yis de rtogs zhes// rjes kyi brjod pas tha snyad byas// spyir ni lnga pa 'od gsal la// sbyor ba'i tshe dang dngos gzhi'i dus// dang po ril 'dzin rjes zhig gis// bden 'dzin lta ci bden med du// zhen pa spong ba'i bar chad med// dngos gzhi'i dus ni de spangs pa'i// rang rig rang gsal rnam grol lam// 'on kyang gzhi dus 'od gsal dang*// rang bzhin dbye bar dka' mod kyi// gzhi dus 'chi ba 'od gsal ba// rnam rtog rlung gis bskyod nus shing*// bskyod las rang bzhin brgyad bcu 'byung*// lam gyi 'od gsal shes sgrib kyi// sa bon drung nas 'byin byed mod// zung 'jug tshe na bsod nams kyi// tshogs rdzogs pa dang spyod pa la// 'jug phyir nyon mongs bag chags dang*// bcas phyir slob pa'i zung 'jug ste// 'od gsal dus su sgrib pa kun// spangs na zung du 'jug pa kun// mi slob kho nar thal ba'am// ci ste yang dag pa yi mtha'// dus min mngon du byas par 'gyur// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o//

dge'o// //shu bhaṃ// //swasti/ khyab bdag 'khor los bsgyur rgyal la// phyag 'tshal gsang ba 'dus chos su// snang mched thob gsum zhes bya ba'i// rnam gzhag bshad pa de bsam bya// sbyang gzhi rdzogs rim mtshan nyid pa'i// snang ba gsum dang sbyor byed kyi// rdzogs rim btags pa pa yi yang*// gsum gsum bshad pa 'dir ngos 'dzin// 'chi ba don dam shes rab kyi// pha rol phyin pa zhes bya ba// rdzogs rim dngos yin der 'jug tshe// snang ba gsum po rim bzhin du// sa rlung chu la thim pa na// mkha' la zla ba shar snang dang*// chu rlung me la thim dus su// nyi shar lta bu'i snang ba dang*// me ni rlung la thim pa'i tshe// thun mtshams smag dang de nas ni// dngos gzhi'i 'od gsal 'char ba las// tha mal 'gro la snang gsum po// lugs las ldog par byung ba'i tshe// nyer thob mun pa lta bu ni// ma rig pa yin de nas ni// snang mched nyi shar lta bu ni// zhe sdang las gyur rtog rnams dang*// snang shar zla ba lta bu ni// 'dod chags las gyur rnam rtog gis// bar do rlung sems las grub pa'i// lus yongs rdzogs par byed de dang*// rnal 'byor pa la 'chi ba yi// sbyor ba snga ma dang mtshungs kyang*// lugs ldog snang gsum chags sogs kyi// rang bzhin brgyad bcus stong par snang*// ci phyir zhe na gzhi dus dang*// lam gyi 'od gsal ro gcig tu// 'dres pa'i stobs las byung phyir ro// rang bzhin 'od gsal las rlung gis// bskyod pa tha mal pa rnams la// rnal 'byor pa rnams las kyi rlung*// 'gog phyir des de bskyod ma nus// de phyir bar do'i rten la ni// longs spyod rdzogs sku dngos dang ni// rjes mthun dngos su byed nus pa// bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa dang*// de rdzogs min pa'i dbye bas so// gnyis pa sbyong byed lam gyis ni// rdzogs rim btags pa bar 'chad tshe// dben gsum cha mthun lus dben dang*// ngag dben las byung dngos gzhi ni// sems dben ming can des mngon byed// bskyed rim dus kyi lta ba dang*// zhi gnas rtse gcig pa las kyang*// du sogs snang ba 'char bshad pa// snang ba gsum gyi rtog can te// ngag dben rdo rje bzlas pa yis// snang ba rnam gsum 'char nus pa// rnam rtog bzhon pa'i rlung 'gags tshe// gsum po'i rgyu tshogs grangs tshang phyir// sems dben dus su dbang gsum pa'i// byed rgyu gang rung mngon sum du// gyur tshe snang gsum lugs 'byung dang*// lugs ldog gnyis ka'i tha mar yang*// 'od gsal rjes mthun pa 'byung ba// gsum pa de ni lung gzhan nas// dga' bzhi lugs las 'byung ldog tu// bshad dang don mthun gzhung 'dir yang*// stong dang shin tu stong pa dang*// chen po stong dang thams cad kyis// stong pa zhes bya'i ming 'dis bshad// de yang 'dod chags sogs gsum dang*// gzung 'dzin kun gyis stong pa la// bshad mod skabs 'dir bden 'dzin gyis// stong yang bden med du 'dzin pas// mi stong phyir na 'od gsal ba'i// rim pa zhes bya der ma son// lugs 'dir rdo rje phreng rgyud las// tha mal dus su 'byung ba bzhin// rlung gi 'byung 'jug gnas gsum po// dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs tshan pa bzhin// lhag chad med par byung ba na// mgon po bzhi po re re la// lha mo bzhi po re re bzhin// nyi brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga re// byung bas yongs rdzogs tshan pa bzhi// dgu brgya phrag rer nges pa dang*// rnam snang sngon po'i rgyu ba ni// 'chi ba'i dus las gzhan mi 'byung*// de lta'i dgu brgya phrag bzhi po// 'pho ba zhag du longs pa'i tshe// nyi khri tshig stong drug brgya'i rlung*// lhag chad med pa byung ba la// rdo rje'i bzlas pa de snyed du// byas pas las rlung de snyed gcig

/dhū tir sim pa las byung ba'i// rtags ni snang ba rnam gsum dang*// rtags can shes pa du sogs su// snang ngo sems la dben par yang*// phyag rgya'i sbyor bas bzung 'dzin gyi// rlung rnams dhū tir zhugs pa na// rtags dang rtags can de lta bur// snang ba de dag ji snyed pa// dpe yi ye shes du 'chad kyi// don gyi ye shes bzhi pa yi// 'od gsal ji srid ma shar ba// de srid mngon du 'gyur ba med// 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dgu brgya pa// phrag bzhi po ni go rim bzhin// rlung me chu sa'i rim pa yis// rgyu ba'am sa chu me rlung gi /rim pas 'pho bar byed kyang rung*// me rlung 'khor bcas lta bu ni// re re la yang dgu brgya phrag /drug drug rdzogs par brtsis pa na// nyin zhag gcig po'i las kyi rlung*// nyi khri chig stong tshang bar 'byung*// 'di dang lung gzhan las gsungs pa// bsres pa min pa rang rang bzhin// bsgrubs pas mchog gyur snang gsum dang*// thun mong dbang dang rgyas la sogs// 'grub 'gyur the tshom med 'di dge /zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim pa lnga rab tu gsal bar byed pa'i brjed byang phyi nang gi mun pa sel byed gzhan la phan pa'i nyi ma zhes bya ba/ gsang chen mtha' dag gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid can gyi bla ma mchog la sgo gsum gus pas phyag bgyi'o// zhes mchod par brjod nas rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/ rgyud gzhan dang ni de mdzad po// gzhan gyis kyang ni 'dir bsngags pa'i// gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim pa lnga// snang byed nyi ma 'di 'char bya// 'dir bshad nyams su blang bya'i chos// ma lus rim pa lngar bsdus pa// klu sgrub zhabs kyi dgongs ji bzhin// dpal ldan zla bar grags pas 'chad// de gang zhe na sngon 'gro ni// dben gsum gyis bsdus dngos gzhi'i chos// bden gnyis so sor dbye ba dang*// mthar thug 'bras bu zung du 'jug

/bshad bya so so'i sgra don dang*// nyams len dngos gzhi'i ngos 'dzin dang*// de sgrub byed po'i rgyu rkyen dang*// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs yan lag go /gzhi gang du ni lus ngag yid// gang gis rnam par dben zhe na// kun tu bzang po'i don dam pa'i// byang chub sems kyi rdo rje ni// ma dag lus dang ngag yid kyis// dben pa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje// lus ni las dang nyon mongs pa'i// rnam smin bdag por bcas dag dang*// bral ba'i don dam ye shes dang*// rlung lnga tshogs pa gcig gyur pa// ma dag ngag ni las kyi rlung*// 'byung 'jug gnas gsum can de yang*// dag pa 'gyur med 'bru gsum gyi// ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa dang*// ma dag sems ni yang dag pa// min pa'i kun rtog rnam shes bya// gzung 'dzin cha dang bral ba yi// ye shes gcig pur gang gyur pa// ci phyir kun rdzob bden ce na// bsgrib bya sgyu ma'i sku de la// sgrib byed rnam par rtog pa yis// bsgribs pa'i phyir na kun rdzob bden// gang gis don dam bden ce na// thams cad stong pa 'od gsal ni// de myong byed po 'phags pa'i blo// kho na nyid phyir dam pa'i don// zla ba rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum du// bshad pa'i stong nyid don dam du// bden par 'chad nus ma yin te// de myong 'phags blo yod min phyir// gnyis po so so'i ngos 'dzin la// thog mar lus dben ngo bo ni// rten dang brten bcas yongs rdzogs pa'i// sbyong byed bskyed rim rtogs bcas te// nyer len sems kyi rdo rje las// gzhan du gsungs pa med gyur mod// gnas skabs de sgrub byed po ni// rtog pa nyid phyir rtog bcas su// bshad mod de mthar phyin pa na// rtog med sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa// de tshe chos rnams thams cad kyi// chos dbyings ye shes rdzogs sangs rgyas// min ni de sgrub byed po'i gzhi// chos rnams kun gyi chos dbyings kyi// ye shes nga zhes zer ba 'gal// de lta na yang las dang po'i// bsgom byung bskyed rim 'di gang gi

/bdag po'i rkyen ni rgyu dus su// bum pa'i dbang bskur pa las te// de ma thag tu thos bsam blo// bskyed rim rnam par snang des bya// spyir ni skyed rdzogs gnyis ka la// rgyu yi dus su dbang bskur nas// thos bsam shes pas smin pa dang*// lam dus su yang so so yi// dbang bskur ba las bsgom byung blo// goms pas grol bar byed pa yi// gnas skabs gnyis gnyis gsungs pa las// lus dben bsgrub pa la 'jug pa'i// thog mar bla ma gzhan las sam// yang na bdag nyid kyis 'jug blang*// de ltar rgyu dang rten bshad nas// bskyed pa'i rim pa la ltos pa'i// bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i thabs// tshogs kyi 'khor lor gang gsungs pa// de yi dbye ba rgyu lam du// dbang gang zhig ni bskur ba dang*// rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang bsgom pa'i// dbye ba las de dper mtshon na// bum pa'i dbang bskur tsam zhus nas// bskyed pa rnal 'byor bzhi rim tsam// nyams myong byed des tshogs 'khor tshe// 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la// ci 'dod par ni bsten bya ru// gsungs pa zhib mo dbye dgos te// de tshe nang mchod yongs rdzogs pa// slob dpon gzhan gyis byin brlabs can// spyad pa rung yang rang gis ni// byin gyis rlobs par nus min te// de byin rlobs pa gsang ba yi// dbang bskur thob la rag las phyir// las dang ye shes phyag rgya yang*// ci bder bten pa 'dis mtshon te// de bstan pa ni gsum pa yi// dbang bskur ba la rag las phyir// 'dis mtshon dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog kyang*// gsum pa'i dbang las ma ltos par// spro bar nus sam mi nus zhes// brtag par bya zhing rjes chags kyi// ting nge 'dzin yang 'dis mtshon no// de lta bas na bskyed rim gyi// gzhung du gsungs pa'i rnal 'byor kun// rdzogs par nyams len byed po ni// dbang bzhi rdzogs par mnos nas so// de phyir rim pa re re la// skal ldan cig char ba yis ni// yongs rdzogs dbang bskur gsum gsum ste// smin dang grol dang tshogs rdzogs byed// skal dman rim gyis pa yis ni// rim pa re re'i sbyor dngos rjes// gsum du dbang bzhin rdzogs par ni// blangs te smin grol tshogs sog bya// tha mal ngag gis dben pa yi// ting 'dzin ngo bo tha mal gyis// 'byung 'jug gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyi// ngo bor bsgrubs pa'i ting 'dzin no// dbye ba brjod bcas dmigs bcas dang*// brdar gyur pa dang don dam mo// dang po sgra dang gnyis pa dang*// gsum bzhi tha snyad dang ye shes// 'jug gnas 'byung gsum 'bru gsum dang*// de gsum sku gsum thugs rdo rje'i// ye shes gsum du grub pa na// snang mched thob gsum rjes mthun pa// 'dir 'grub bskyed rim skabs su yang*// yin no de der ma zad kyi// sa chu me rlung bzhi po la// rdo rje'i bzlas pas 'byung ba bzhi// rim gyis 'gag cing man ngag gi

/rlung las rdo rje'i bzlas goms pas// 'byung ba las gyur bzhi po yang*// des na rdo rje'i bzlas goms pa// rnam smin phung po myur du ni// 'dor byed ring ba'i rgyu dang ni// thun mong dngos grub rnam bzhi dang*// stong nyid lta ba'i nye rgyu yang*// yin te dper na yid mig rlung*// gzugs la bsgrims pas gsal snang dang*// mi dmigs par yang gyur rjes su// du sogs rtags can skye phyir ro// 'dir yang bsod nams tshogs rdzogs pa'i// phyir du tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rim// rgyu lam dus su gsum pa'i dbang*// sngon du song na yongs rdzogs dang*// de ma song na rdo rje yi// slob dpon las ni de thob par// byas nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor// sems kyi rnam par dben pa yi// ngo bo snang ba rnam gsum ste// bdag po'i rkyen ni dbang gsum pa// thun mong dbang rnams dang bcas te// snga ma'i rim pa gnyis dus su// skyes pa'i snang gsum rjes mthun pa// de ma thag pa'i rkyen yang ngo*// de der ma zad lam dus kyi// dbang gsum pa las 'di'i skabs kyi// snang gsum dngos dang 'od gsal ba// rjes mthun pa yang bskyed dgos te// rgyud gzhan las gsungs dga' bzhi dang*// de tshe don gcig bshad phyir ro// snang gsum 'od gsal dang bcas pa'i// ming gi rnam grangs stong pa bzhir// bshad de chags sdang rmongs gsum dang*// rtog pa thams cad kyis stong pa// dus de'i stong nyid bzhi pa ni// dpe yi ye shes dngos yin phyir// de yi stobs kyis snang gsum yang*// rtog dang bral ba'i rig pa yin// 'di tsam kho na'i byed pa yis// sgyu ma'i skur ni bzhengs nus kyang*// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs bya phyir du// tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshang bar bskor// rdo rje'i slob dpon mthu grub pas// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i ched du ni// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo// lha grangs sum cu so gnyis po// bskyed pa'i cho ga tshul bzhin du// bsgrubs pas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor der// bum pa'i dbang bskur ma lus dang*// gong ma'i dbang bskur rnam gsum yang*// skal bar ldan pa'i slob ma la// bskur bas thob cing tshogs 'khor ba// rang rang gis kyang slob dpon las// dbang bskur ma lus nyams myong dang*// slob dpon gyis kyang rang stobs las// 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la// ci 'dod par ni bsten par bya// sngags pas spyod pa la 'jug pa'i// dngos gzhi tshogs kyi 'khor lo la// longs spyod yin par gsungs pa las// 'byor ldan shes rab chung ba yis// spros bcas tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*// 'byor dang shes rab 'bring po yis// spros med tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*// 'byor chung rtogs pa chen po yis// shin tu spros med tshogs 'khor bskor// rgyas par zung 'jug skabs nyid du// bshad par bya ba yin mod kyi// rim pa re re dang 'brel ba'i// tshogs kyi 'khor lo ma bskor na// yang dag mtha' la dus min du// zhugs pa'i nyes par ma zad kyi// sgyu ma'i sku mngon byed par yang*// mi nus pa'am dus min du// byed pa'i nyes pa dang bcas te// sku ni rang dang 'tshams pa yi// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs las byung phyir// gsum pa kun rdzob bden dngos kyi// ngo bo sgyu ma lta bu yi// lha sku dpa' bo gcig pa'am// dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs par snang ba'i// shes pa rtog bral ma 'khrul ba// de yang sgyu ma'i sku nyid do// bdag rkyen rgyu lam dus kyi ni// dbang bskur las yin nyer len rgyu// snang gsum dpe yi 'od gsal dang*// bcas gang rtog bral ma 'khrul ba// de las de sgrub byed pa yi// thog mar de mngon bya snyam pa'i// rnam rtog 'bad rtsol du ma dang*// bcas pas man ngag gzhung bzhin du// gnas khang mngon par 'du byas nas// 'od zer rnam lnga'i tshogs rdzogs par// byas pa'i bris sku dgram pa dang*// de la nyi ma'i zer 'phog par// byas pa'i mdun du g.ya' dag pa'i// me long khang pa'i ngos dag la// gzar bas de la gzugs brnyan ni// gang shar zangs chen chu mtshor yang*// 'char bar byas nas bsgrub bya ba// skye mched gsal tshul me long du// shar ba dang ni 'od zer lnga// 'phro tshul nam mkha'i 'ja' bzhin du// rgyud dag pa ni thams cad la// khyad par chu yi zla ba ltar// ngo 'phrod byas nas rang rig pa// rang gsal g.yo byed kha dog gi

/'od zer lnga dang ldan gyur pa// de nyid kun slong shugs kyis sam// dus mnyam 'tshogs pa'i rnam rtog gis// bzo bos lhag pa'i lhar bsgrubs mod// rang gi ngo bo rtog med de// gzugs la blta 'dod blta bzhin pa'i// rtog pas bskrun pa'i mig shes bzhin// lung gzhan dag tu bskyed rim las// gzhan pa'i lhag pa'i lha bsgrubs pa// ma bshad pas na sgyu ma'i sku// bsgrub tshul 'phags pa yab sras kyi// lugs bzang thun mong min gsung mod// bskyed rim dus kyi rtog pa'i bsgom// goms byed yan lag ma bral bar// bsgom pa yongs su rdzogs pa na// de gsal mi rtog blo 'bras can// de nyid yin par kho bo 'dod// 'di la rdzogs rim lha zhes pa'i// tha snyad bod byon snga mas mdzad// rdzogs rim lha yi bsgrub tshul 'di// gang du yod pa'i gzhung de na// gtum mos rnam smin lus gang po// 'ja' mtshon lta bu bsgrub pa'i thabs// ma bshad gang du de bshad par// sgyu lus sgrub tshul 'di mi 'chad// yin pa'i phyir na 'di bsgrub pa'i// thabs mkhas de las rnam smin gyi// phung po sbrul gyi shun pa ltar// brjes nas 'bor ba yin zhes pa// klu sgrub zhabs kyis rnam smin lus// sa stengs bzhag nas zung 'jug sku// mngon du byas pa ji bzhin no// zhes zer ba dang 'phags pa yis// zung 'jug bar do'i lus rten la// mngon du mdzad ces zer ba snang*// bod gzhung mdzad pa phyi ma 'ga'// rnam smin lus dang nga tsam dang*// yid kyi rnam shes lhar bsgrub pa// bskyed pa'i rim yin de las gzhan// sems can kun la yod pa yi// gnyug ma gzhi lus lhar bsgrub pa'i// thabs mchog bla na med pa 'di// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rgyu mthun gyi// rigs 'dra snga mas de bsgrub pa'i// thabs 'di gzhung gzhan la med par// dpal ldan 'dus pa'i khyad chos zer// 'o na bskyed rim gyis bsgrubs pa'i// gzugs sku mi bskyod rdo rje dang*// gzhi lus rgyus bsgrubs gzugs kyi sku// mi bskyod rdo rje rdzas gzhan pa// gnyis shig sgrub pa po gcig la// mnyam du grub par khas len nam// yang na bskyed pa'i rim pa las// dngos su byung ba'i lha yi sku// med par khas len byed yin nam// yin te bskyed rim rtog bsgom dang*// gzugs sku'i mtshams du rdzogs pa'i rim// mang pos bar du chod zhe na// cig shos la yang 'di mtshungs te// kun rdzob bden dang zung 'jug gi

/bar du 'od gsal don dam pa'i// bden pas chod pa nyid phyir ro// sgrub pa po 'ga'i ming gzugs kyi// phung po mngon par sangs rgyas pa// de tshe rnam smin phung po ni// shul du lus pa ga la srid// gzugs kyi phung po lus snyam na// sgrub pa po la rang gi lus// phung po snang ba'i rnam rig las// gzhan pa'i gzugs phung yod ma yin// rnam rig rdzogs sangs rgyas blor 'dus// klu sgrub sku lus gzhan dag la// rnam smin phung por snang gang des// snang blo de rang nyid yin gyi// rang dang gzhan gyi blo snang las// ma gtogs rnam smin phung mi srid// de phyir chos dbyings ye shes ni// longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhengs pa'i tshe// sgrub pa po rang so so yi// ma dag phung po dbyings su thim// de ltar bskyed rim rnal 'byor pa'i// dmigs rnam gsal bas bdag rkyen dang*// rdo rje'i bzlas pas sbyangs pa'i rlung*// 'od zer lnga pas g.yo ba'i rkyen// byas pas ye shes gzugs kyi skur// ye shes yul can la sbyangs pa// 'di yi gnas lugs don dam bden// 'di las gzhan na sgrub pa po'i// rnam smin phung po sangs rgyas kyis// ma gzigs phyir na yod ma yin// de lta na yang 'od gsal ba// ji srid mthar phyin ma gyur pa// de srid rtog dang bcas pa'i phyir// don dam 'ba' zhig par ma bzhag /'o na dben pa rnam gsum la// sgyu ma'i lha sku yod min par// bshad dang ma mthun gyur zhe na// de yi skabs kyi dben gsum po// ma dag lus ngag yid gsum la// dgongs par gsal te rdul phra rab// 'dus pa'i phyir sogs sgrub byed gsum// bkod pa'i skabs las gsal ba yin// de ltar sgyu ma'i sku grub nas// lo'am zla ba'i grangs dag tu// tshogs kyi 'khor lo yongs rdzogs pa// bskor bar byas te mi slob pa'i// zung 'jug sku gsum mngon gyur pa'i// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs bya phyir du'o// bskyed rim dus su ma dag pa'i// phung khams skye mched ma dmigs dang*// ngag dben dus su rnam rtog gi

/bzhon par gyur rnams khegs pa dang*// sems dben rang bzhin brgyad bcu po'i// gnyen po nyid phyir dben gsum gyi// mnyam gzhag dus su sgrib pa gnyis// mngon gyur mgo gnon byas phyir dang*// sgyu lus skabs kyi rjes thob 'di// cir snang sgyu mar shar ba dang*// rang nyid sgyu ma'i sku bsgrub pas// chos dang gang zag du 'dzin pa'i// 'gal zla nges 'byed cha mthun dang*// mtshungs pas 'jig rten par yang bzhag /phyi rabs pa 'ga' sgrub pa po// rang nyid sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa'i// ngal bas snod bcud ma lus pa// sgyu mar mi 'dod pas 'dir nong*// sgyu ma'i lha sku bsgrub pa'i gzhi// rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i lus// yin par bshad mod de'i rnam bzhag /lus 'di sems can thams cad la// rang chas nyid du yod phyir na// mngal du ma skyes snga rol dang*// rnam smin lus rjes gyur nas kyang*// lus 'di 'dor bar mi 'gyur zhing*// de dus rlung dang sems kyi ni// yan lag rlung dang rtsa ba yi// rlung gzhan ma yin srog gi rlung*// kho na nyid dang sems kyang ni// dbang shes ma yin yid kyi ni// rnam shes 'ba' zhig pa nyid zer// sgrub pa po de shi 'og tu// yid kyi rnam shes mi 'dor bar// 'dod dam 'bor dang mi 'bor ba'i// rnam shes rdzas gzhan gnyis khas len// dang po ltar na gzhi dus kyi// snang gsum 'char tshul kun las nyams// gnyis pa ltar na sems can kun// yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni// rgyud re re bar bshad dang 'gal// spyir yang yid kyi dbang po la// rag las min pa'i yid rnam shes// ji ltar yin pa khyed kyis ston// drug po 'gags ma thag pa dang*// nyon mongs can yid las gzhan pa'i// yid dbang chos nas gsungs pa med// gzhi lus yid kyi shes pa yi// bdag rkyen gang zhig yin pa smros// srog rlung de yi ngos 'dzin yang*// rnal 'byor pa rang nyid kyi'am// rdzas gzhan gyur pa gzhan zhig yin// dang po ltar na mngal bzung ba'i// snga rol nyid nas yod zer dang*// shi ba'i 'og tu'ang yod pa 'gal// shi ba'i srog rlung mi 'dor ba'i// sems can de dag khams gsum po// gang du skyes kyang mir gyur pa'i// srog dang bcas par thal 'gyur te// sgyu lus sgrub pa'i gzhi bcas phyir// phar phyin pa dag rta glang du// snang yang der yod min pa'i dpes// chos kun mtshon par byed mod kyi// 'dir ni rnam rtog bzhon pa'i rlung*// khegs pas gnyis med ye shes de// ye shes rlung gi bzhon pa dang*// tshogs pa gcig gyur sgyu ma'i sku// chos dbyings de las ma gtogs pa'i// chos gzhan 'dir yod ma yin pa// de phyir sngags kyi sgyu ma ni// pha rol phyin pa las khyad 'phags// bzhi pa 'od gsal rim pa yis// ngo bo rang rig rang gsal ba// gzung dang 'dzin pa kun bral ba'i// ye shes dam pa'i don nyid do// bdag rkyen rgyu dang lam dus kyi// dbang bskur ba dang nyer len rgyu// snang gsum dpe yi 'od gsal dang*// bcas yin de nyid sgyu lus kyi'ang*// gnas tshul nyid du yod phyir ro// sgyu lus grub rjes 'od gsal ba// ji ltar bsgrub pa'i rim pa ni// ril por 'dzin dang rjes su gzhig

/ces bya'i man ngag rnam gnyis kyi// sgyu ma'i gzugs sku 'od gsal ba'i// ngo bo nyid du bcug pas so// 'bad rtsol du mas bsgrub pa'i sku// 'od gsal nyid du 'jug byed na// glang chen khrus 'drar mi 'gyur ram// bcug pa'i dgos pa ci zhe na// sgyu mar zhen pa'i rnam rtog gis// 'dzin pa spang bar bya phyir te// sgyu ma'i sku la der zhen pas// bden gnyis so so tha dad par// bzung bas de tha dad min pa'i// zung 'jug sku la gegs byed 'gyur// phyi rabs pa 'ga' chos kun la// sgyu mar zhen pa yul gyi ni// gnas tshul yin phyir spang mi dgos// spong na sgyu ma 'khrul 'gyur lo// de skad lung rigs du ma yis// bkag zin phyir na 'dir mi 'bad// don gyi 'od gsal dngos gzhi la// 'jug byed ting 'dzin gnyis po'i ming*// ril por 'dzin pa bdag dang ni// khams gsum ma lus cig char du// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi// lha skur bsgrubs nas so so yi// dam tshig ye shes ting nge 'dzin// rnam gsum rim bzhin ches phra bar// gyur nas stong nyid du 'jug dang*// bdag dang snang ba so so bar// byas nas de dang der grub pa// rim pa ji bzhin snga ma ltar// byas nas stong nyid du 'jug pa'o// 'od gsal ba la shes sgrib kyi// sa bon spong byed gnyen po dang*// rnam par grol ba'i lam gnyis su// don gyis 'thob bo de la yang*// dang por mngon du byas tsam dang*// de goms byed pa'i dbye ba yis// mthong dang sgom pa'i lam dag tu// 'byed pa gdon mi za ba yin// de lta na yang spyod pa yis// mi slob zung 'jug pa nyid du// 'jug la dgos pa'i nyon mongs pa// 'ga' zhig 'od gsal 'dis mi spong*// spang bya min par thal zhe na// 'bras bu nyid dang mtshams sbyor ba'i// lhan skyes dga' ba bzhi pa'i ming*// thams cad stong pa'i 'od gsal zhes// bya ba des spong ci phyir na// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// nyon mongs pa dang shes sgrib kyi// bag la nyal kun cig char du// spong zhes bshad dang mtshungs phyir ro// kun rdzob bden la so so dang*// zung 'jug gnas skabs gnyis bshad bzhin// 'od gsal ba la'ang de lta bu// gnyis la phyi mas mi spong ba'i// sgrib kun bag chags yod ma yin// dben gsum sgyu ma'i skur byas pa// thog ma'i sa mtshams nges 'byed dang*// mngon du gyur nas mthar phyin pa// zung 'jug mi slob pa'i tshe yang*// yin no bzhi pa 'od gsal gyi// thog ma'i sa mtshams gsang sngags kyi// mthong ba'i lam de mthar phyin pa// mi slob zung 'jug ngo bo nyid// sngon dang phyi ma'i dus 'dir yang*// 'od gsal ngos 'dzin stong pa nyid// med par dgag las gzhan med pa// zla ba'i dgongs pa yin zer dang*// bde dang stong pa chu la ni// chu bzhag ji bzhin gzung ba dang*// 'dzin pa rgyang chad yod min pa// 'od gsal 'di yi ngos 'dzin zer// lugs dang po ni zla grags kyis// pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags kyi// stong nyid 'chad tshul so so ba// de ma shes pa des nongs so// 'chad tshul dang pos mnyam gzhag tshe// med par dgag pa'i stong nyid las// ma gtogs chos 'ga' yod min phyir// mnyam par bzhag tshe blo med par// gyur kyang sbyor ba'i dus kyi ni// 'phen pa'i dbang gis rjes thob tu// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs byed pa'i blo// byed po rang gi rgyud la 'byung*// rdzogs sangs rgyas tshe de lta bu// 'phen pa med cing dus rtag tu// mnyam par bzhag phyir rang rgyud kyis// bsdus pa'i ye shes med par bshad// 'dus pa'i gzhung 'di sgron gsal gyis// 'chad tshe sangs rgyas chos thams cad// zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs sku las// gzhan yod min pa nyid phyir ro// gang du longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// 'chad byed yod pa'i gzhung der ni// bde stong kha sbyor las gzhan pa// bshad pa'i go skabs yod ma yin// 'od gsal med dgag la 'chad tshe// dka' ba'i gnas de gzigs gyur nas// zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang zhes pa// sa bcu pa la 'chad ces zer// rdzogs sangs rgyas la blo med ces// 'chad pa sngags na med mod kyi// dbu ma dang ni spyod pa la// 'jug pa rnam gnyis byed po yis// de tshe de yod min pa ni// gsal bar bshad la bsnyon mi nus// de tshe rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la// skur pa btab ces gsungs mod kyang*// chos rnams rang rang ngo bo yis// stong tshul zol zog yod min par// bshad tshul shes na sngar bshad pa// de las gzhan du 'chad mi nus// de 'dra don dam par yin mod// tha snyad 'jog tshe de la de// yod ma yin na gzhung lugs kun// nyams par 'gyur ba nyid ce na// de ltar yin no de'i shes byed// mtha' yas gdul bya'i bsod nams dang*// sngon dus rang rang smon lam gyis// sa bcu pa dang gzhan dag la// longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i skur// snang la stobs sogs yon tan chos// de rang nyid kyis bsdus lta bur// snang phyir de la de yod par// tha snyad dus su rnam 'jog pa'i// gzhung lugs de kun nyams mi mnga'// lugs gnyis pa des stong nyid kyi// ngos 'dzin zla grags dbu mar ni// bshad las gzhan du mi 'chad cing*// yul can bde bas de rtogs pa'i// mthar thug 'od gsal yin zer ba// gzhi yi dus kyi 'od gsal ba// ngos 'dzin gang gis gang rtogs par// bshad nus min phyir dus de na// 'od gsal min par khyed 'dod dam// de lta na ni de dus kyi// don dam bden pa'i ngos 'dzin ci// med par dgag pa don dam du// bzhed pa sngags na lta ci smos// pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs kyi// mthar thug gang na'ang yod ma yin// bde dang stong pa ro gcig par// song zhes 'chad pa'i don gang yin// bde ba stong pa ro gcig na// nam mkha' lta bu las gzhan med// stong pa bde bar ro gcig na// lhan skyes ye shes las gzhan med// khyed kyis bde ba ngos 'dzin tshe// las kyi phyag rgya las byung ba'i// zag bcas bde ba la bshad pa// ha cang thal phyir spro mi dgos// lnga pa zung 'jug ngo bo ni// 'od gsal ba dang sgyu ma'i sku// gnyis su byar yod ma yin pa'i// mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'o// 'di nyid 'od gsal bar gnas shing*// 'od gsal ba yang 'di nyid du// gnas phyir sku 'di 'od gsal du// slar 'jug dgos pa ma yin no// de phyir 'di ni don dam pa'i// bden phyir kun rdzob dang mi mtshungs// longs spyod rdzogs sku kun rdzob kyi// bden pa kho nar bzhed rnams kyi// zung 'jug ngo bo kun rdzob kyi// bden par bshad pas nongs min nam// zung 'jug bdag rkyen dbang bskur ni// 'od gsal dus kyi dbang de las// gzhan min 'di dag 'od gsal gyi// bar na rjes shes yod min tshe'o// nyer len kun rdzob sgyu ma dang*// lugs ldog snang gsum ye shes te// 'od gsal med par dgag yin na// snang gsum ye shes rgyu ci las// 'od gsal ngo bo bde chen na// kun rdzob bden par ma smras sam// zung 'jug ji ltar bsgrub rim ni// sgyu ma grub nas 'od gsal du// 'jug pa'i dus der 'di snyam ste// lo'am zla ba'i bar dag tu// 'od gsal ba la mnyam bzhag nas// skabs su snang gsum lugs ldog ste// zung 'jug mngon du bya'o zhes// 'phen pa btang nas bsgrub dgos te// 'od gsal ba dang snang gsum gyi// skabs na longs skur bzhengs 'dod pa'i// kun slong rnam rtog med phyir dang*// gsum po bar chad med skye'i phyir// 'od gsal bar chad med lam gyis// sgrib pa ma lus kun spong na// zung du 'jug par bzhengs rjes su// tshogs 'khor sogs bya'i kun slong dang*// spyod pa rnam gsum mthar phyin pa'i// rkyen gang yin pa smos zhe na// 'od gsal bar chad med lam gyis// mthong dang sgom pas spang bya bar// bshad rnams ma lus spong byed mod// der ma bshad pa'i rnam rtog dang*// chags chen yan lag du dgos pa'i// nyon mongs mi spong ba'i rang bzhin// 'od gsal ngo na gnyen po yi// rnam par rtog pa kun bral yang*// de las bzhengs pa'i zung 'jug tshe// bya byed rtog pa kun mi spong*// 'od gsal pa na zung 'jug tu// bzhengs pa'i 'phen pa gtong byed tshe// dbang po'i rim pa rnam gsum ste// brtson 'grus can dang le lo can// bar chad can zhes bya ba las// 'od gsal ba las zung 'jug tu// ldang la tshegs yod ma yin yang*// zung 'jug rten la spyod pa rnams// spyod pa'i mthun rkyen tshang ba dang*// ma tshang ba las rim bzhin du// tshang ba'i 'byor ldan brtson 'grus can// tshe 'di nyid la rdzogs sangs rgya// sgyu ma grub pa'i le lo can// sngon du srid pa'i rten de la// 'od gsal sgrub pa'i rtsol med pas// 'chi ba 'od gsal mngon gyur tshe// sngon gyi man ngag dran byas nas// 'od gsal ma dang bu 'phrad pa// lta bur byas nas lugs ldog gi

/snang ba gsum las zung 'jug sku// rim gyis mngon du bya'o zhes// 'phen pa btang nas 'od gsal la// 'jug par byed pa kho na'o// sgyu ma grub pa'i bar chad can// bden pa ma mthong smos ci dgos// bden mthong gyur kyang spyod pa la// 'jug pa'i mthun rkyen ma tshang ba'am// tshang yang brtson 'grus mi rtsom pas// 'od gsal ba la mi 'jug pa'am// zhugs kyang sngon dus 'chi srid dang*// bar do'i srid pa gang la yang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas mi 'dod pa'o// 'od gsal ba las zung 'jug tu// 'jug pa'i sa mtshams gang zhe na// mthong bas spang bya'i sgrib pa kun// spangs pa'i rnam grol lam nas sam// sgom pas spang bya re re kun// spangs pa'i sa bdun nas kyang ste// dag pa'i sa gsum nas ni de// mngon du byed na dka' ba'i gnas// ci phyir zhe na gsum po yi// rjes shes la yang sgra dang don// 'dres 'dzin rtogs pa bkag phyir ro// de med na ni bsod nams kyi// tshogs rdzogs pa yin kun slong dang*// tha na shin tu spros med du// dgos pa'i rtog pa 'gag phyir ro// 'od gsal ba ni zung 'jug sku// mngon du byed la gegs med cing*// zung 'jug nas ni spyod pa gsum// mi 'byung mi srid de yi phyir// bden pa mthong nas las mtha' la// chags pas spyod la mi 'jug pa// de 'dra ci yi phyir zhe na// dpe yi ye shes bden mthong du// btags zhes sa skya pas gsungs dang*// spyod bsdus sgron ma'i dgongs 'chad tshe// le lo can gang bar do ru// zung du 'jug la dgongs zer mod// 'od gsal ba la 'jug pa'i tshe// 'phen pa ji ltar btang la so// 'o na sa bdun man chad du// 'od gsal ba las zung 'jug skur// bzhengs tshe bar chad gzhan yod na// zung du 'jug pa'i rgyu dang rkyen// gang zhig yin pa smros zhe na// dben gsum las ni kun rdzob kyi// bden par 'jug pa'i rgyu rkyen bzhin// bden pa mthong ba'i rjes su yang*// gsum pa'i dbang las lugs 'byung dang*// lugs ldog dga' ba bzhi rnyed pa// de la lugs 'dir stong pa bzhi// snang gsum 'od gsal dang bcas pa'i// rgyu las zung 'jug sku 'grub par// tshegs yod min mod de yang ni// sngon gyi 'phen pa'i dbang la sogs// phung po'i za ma tog nang du// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku sgrub tshe// ma dag rnam smin phung po yi// yid kyi rnam shes 'khor bcas pa// longs spyod rdzogs sku grub min nam// grub na de grub tsam nyid nas// rnam smin 'dir nus min pa ci// de dus de der ma grub na// sgrub pa po dang grub pa'i 'bras// 'brel med gyur pa ma yin nam// zhe na bdag byin brlab rim pas// bdag gam sgrub gzhi zung 'jug tu// grub kyang de sgrub byed pa pos// bsod nams tshogs chen ma rdzogs pa// de srid phung po 'dir mi byed// bsod nams tshogs de gang zhe na// gong ma'i rim pa re re yi// skabs su'ang bshad zin pa de dang*// bye brag 'dir ni mi slob pa'i// zung 'jug sku dang mtshams sbyor ba'i// spyod pa'i tshogs su bshad rnams so// spyod pas mtshams sbyar zin 'og tu// sbrul gyi shun pa brjes pa na// shun pa bzhag nas sbrul song ltar// rnam smin shul du bzhag ces pa// spyod bsdus sogs kyi dgongs pa ni// yin zhes zer mod dka' ba'i gnas// spyod pa'i tshogs rnams byed pa po// khams drug lus can de min nam// byed pos zung 'jug mi 'grub par// de min pas 'grub ha cang thal// sgrub pa po dang de grub pa// rgyu gcig yin phyir nyes med na// 'o na byed po zung 'jug tu// grub pa ci phyir 'di mi 'dod// byed po'i rnam shes 'khor bcas pa// de grub na yang gzugs phung po// der mi 'grub pas skyon med na// 'o na ming gzhi'i tshogs rnams kun// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bsgrubs gzhir thal// 'dor na de sgrub byed pa'i gzhi// sgrub po ma skyes snga rol nas// yod dang shi ba'i 'og tu yang*// gzhi lus yod par 'dod dang 'gal// sol ba dung du mi 'gyur ltar// gzugs phung sangs mi rgya zer mod// phyi rol don la zhen ches pas// theg chen gzhung lugs 'chad mi nus// de phyir gsang ba 'dus pa yi// sgrub po rnal 'byor pa de'i ngor// chos can rten 'brel sna tshogs kyi// gang snang de yi chos dbyings kyi// ye shes ro gcig tu gyur pa// rdzogs sangs rgyas tshe kun rdzob kyi// chos kun rang rang ngo bo yis// stong phyir shul du lus pa med// rgyal po in+t+ra bhū ti yang*// btsun mo'i tshogs bcas zung 'jug tu// mngon du mdzad tshe ma dag lus// gang gang shul du lus pa smos// spyod pa la sogs bsod nams tshogs// byed po kun rdzob pa de yis// rang gi ye shes don dam pa// rdzogs sangs rgya phyir 'bad pa las// dam pa'i bdag de zung 'jug skur// rdzogs sangs rgyas tshe de las gzhan// kun rdzob 'ga' yang dmigs med na// rnam smin phung sogs smos ci dgos// slob bzhin pa yis zung 'jug sku// mngon gyur tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*// spyod gsum gang rung sbyong byed pa// 'byor pa dang ni dbang po dang*// na tshod rab 'bring mtha' ma yi// dbye bas tshogs 'khor rgyas 'bring bsdus// spros bcas spros med spyod pa gsum// gang la bslabs kyang mi slob pa'i// zung 'jug 'grub la khyad med ces// shing dang 'dab ma ras bal gsum// bsreg la thal bar khyed med pa'i// dpe yis rgyas par gsungs de la// rnal 'byor pa yis blos dpyad bya// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs byed pa'i thabs// tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas pa ni// byed po de yis rgyu dus su// dbang bskur ba nas stong nyid kyi// lta bar thos dang bsam pa dang*// lam gyi dus su sgom pa yis// nyams myong ba ni tshogs 'khor lo'i// med na mi 'byung rgyu yin phyir// de med na de des mi bya// snod min skye bos ma sbags pa'i// gnas khang yid 'ong nyams dga' bar// dam tshig sdom pa dang ldan pa'i// slob ma'i tshogs kun rdo rje yi// slob dpon dang bcas yo byad rnams// ma tshang med par 'byor byas nas// gang 'di'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi// sgrub thabs tshang bar goms byas nas// slob dpon las sam bdag nyid kyis// 'jug pa'i tshul gyis dbang blang ba// nyams myong gyur nas lhag pa'i lhar// sbyor ba nyams pa med bzhin du// 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la// ji tsam 'dod pa bstan par bya// bsten par byed po kun rdzob dang*// dam pa'i don gyi bdag gnyis las// phyi ma lhag pa'i lhar grub pa// longs spyod byed po dngos de nyid// longs spyod byas pa'ang kun rdzob dang*// de yis chos dbyings ye shes las// phyi ma spyad bya dngos min par// shes nas tshogs kyi 'khor lor spyod// kun rdzob snang ba'i bya byed po// yod ma yin par don dam gyi// bya byed de dag mi 'grub mod// dam pa'i don gyi bya byed las// nyams myong med par kun rdzob kyi// bya byed las gsum byed pa po// tha mal pa yi de dang de// byed dang mtshungs phyir 'khor ba'i rgyu// 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la// ci 'dod par ni bsten byas na// kun rdzob dbang lus rgyas byed mod// de 'dra lhag pa'i lha mchod pa'i// yan lag min par thal zhe na// kun rdzob khams drug rnam rgyus pa'i// dbang lus zhu bde lhan skyes kyi// med na mi 'byung rgyu yin phyir// de bstan pa las de grub 'gyur// de nas bsod nams tshogs chen po'i// pha rol son pa nyid phyir dang*// nyon mongs pa dang shes sgrib kyi// bag chags zad par bya phyir dang*// thams cad mkhyen phyir spyod pa gsum// gang yang rung la bslab bya ba// 'byor chen ldan pa'i gnas khang gi

/mtshan nyid yongs su ldan gang der// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi grangs// ma tshang med par 'byor byas nas// sta gon nas ni dngos gzhi'i bar// rdzogs par goms bya thig rnams dang*// so so'i tshom bus lha yi gnas// ma 'chol rigs par bkod byas nas// gsang ba 'dus pa lha dgu'am// bcu gsum ma nas so gnyis bar// mir gyur rnal 'byor pho mo'i tshogs// rang rang gnas su bkod byas nas// rdo rje slob dpon mthun grub pas// dkyil 'khor pa rnams rang rang gi /lhag pa'i lha ni de dang der// yongs su rdzogs par sgrub pa'i tshul// dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ji bzhin dang*// mchod tshogs las ni rgyal mchog bzhin// grub par byas pa'i slob dpon gyis// thun mong dbang dgu gsang ba dang*// khyad par shes rab ye shes kyi// dbang bskur ba ni 'dir bskur bya// de tshe zung 'jug sgrub pa po// rigs lnga'i ldog pas rang rang gi /'bag tu zhugs la slob dpon gyis// re re la yang spyan ma sogs// bzhi bzhir stob pa spros bcas kyi// tshe na yin gsungs spros med tshe// rigs lnga dang mthun phyag rgya lnga// yang na dpa' bo gcig pu yis// reg bya rdo rje ma gcig dang*// sgyu rtsal bstan bcos las 'byung ltar// tshul bzhin snyoms par zhugs byas pas// rim bzhin snang ba rnam gsum po// rang bzhin brgyad bcus stong gsum dang*// thams cad stong pa'i 'od gsal ni// tho rangs dus su mngon gyur pa// de las yang ni lugs ldog pa'i// snang gsum rtse mo der son nas// thams cad stong pa'i 'od gsal dang*// gnyis su byar yod ma yin pa'i// longs spyod rdzogs sku der bzhengs so// de tshe lugs 'byung snang gsum gyi// rgyun mthar skyes pa'i 'od gsal de// sgrib gnyis bag chags kun sel ba'i// dngos gnyen bar chad med lam ste// lugs ldog snang ba rnam gsum po// rnam par grol ba'i lam dang ni// de mthar 'khrungs pa'i zung 'jug sku// mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs// kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan pa// mthar phyin tshul gang 'dir grub pa// yang na shin tu spros med kyi// spyod pa la 'jug byed pa ni// rnam g.yeng chung dang rgan po dang*// dbang po rno dang rim pa lnga'i// nyams myongs sa bcu par son pas// gnod sbyin mo sogs dbang byas te// nam mkha'i mdzod ltar 'byor pa'i tshogs// char bzhin 'bebs pa'i dben gnas su// ye shes phyag rgya tsam bsten nas// dga' ba bzhi pa'i rtse mor ni// longs spyod 'byor rdzogs skur bzhengs so// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// slar smras pa// bla ma rnams dang lhag pa'i lha// gang la gang gis ji ltar yang*// phyag byas pa ni tha dad du// yod ma yin pas phyag bgyis nas// gang la gang gis dngos gang zhig

/mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam gsum po// so sor yod ma yin tshul gyis// legs par bshad 'di mchod par 'bul// gnas gang du ni byed pa po// gang gis legs par bshad gang 'di// rang gis bshad dang gzhan gyis ni// ma bshad ces byar mi 'chad kyang*// sngon rabs la las ma bshad dang*// phyi rabs pa 'gas log par yang*// bshad pa'i rjes su 'brangs min par// bshad kyang rlom pas sbags min pa// byed pa gang gis yul gang du// bsngo dang ji ltar bsngo ba yang*// rnam gsum dmigs pa med tshul gyis// zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs phyir bsngo// sngon 'gro dben pa rnam gsum dang*// dngos gzhi bden gnyis so so dang*// mthar thug don dam 'ba' zhig pas// dpal ldan 'dus pa'i gzhung lugs kyi// lus rnam gzhag pa kun bsdus pa'i// yan lag cung zad rgyas bshad pas// thog mar rang blo'i mun bsal nas// de nas gzhan phan nyi ma yis// la la'i rmongs pa sel ba dang*// bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas par shog /ces 'di mchog ldan legs pa'i blo// rang lo don drug par longs pa'i// thog mar sbyar ba 'di'i dge bas// lo 'di dge zhing shis gyur cig/ //shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam bzhag/ ༈ /na mo mañdzu badz+ra ya/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba gsum// gcig tu 'dus pa'i yab gcig po// rdo rje lha mo bcas khyod la// gnyis su med par phyag bgyi'o// rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gcig bsdus sku// sgrub thabs dam chos gsung gi mdzod// de sgrub byed la ngal med thugs// gang la mnga' ba kun la yang*// phyogs lhung med par dad byas nas// chos la rtog pa'i rnam dpyod kyis// rnam par brtags gang ngo mtshar bas// dkon mchog rnam gsum mchod par 'bul// gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs la// gang gis sgrub dang gang las bsgrub// sgrub thabs ngo bo sgrub pa yi// 'bras bu'i gnas la brtag bya ba// 'di na mkhas 'ga' gsang sngags kyi// sgrub por ma zad theg gsum 'bras// gang gis sgrub pa las 'bras kyi// rten gyur bdag de yin zhes smras// 'dir de mi 'thad phar phyin du'ang*// mu stegs gzhung dang khyad par ci// grol ba po ni med na yang*// log par sgro btags gzhom phyir brtson// ma btags gcig pur nyams dga' ba'i// tshe na nga dang bdag zer mod// 'jig rten 'das pa rang gi lugs// 'jog tshe des de'i go mi chod// gsang sngags sgrub po stong nyid kyi// ye shes rdo rje nga zhes dang*// dhar+m+ma dhā du swa bha wa// at+ma ko haṃ zhes bya bas// sgrub po ngos 'dzin 'di'i rnam grangs// de bzhin nyid dag dag pa'i bdag

/dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyu yi rgyud// spros kun nyer zhi dam pa'i bdag /so so rang rig spyod yul te// gang gis dang po'i sangs rgyas 'di// ngo ma 'phrod par gsang sngags kyi// tshul mi shes zhes pad dkar pos// dri med 'od du gsungs min nam// de nas rten dang brten par bcas// gang las sgrub pa'i gzhi dpyad pa// stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las dang*// pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las shes// goms pas 'don mod de de ci// rang ma rdzogs sangs rgyas blo'am// nam mkha' lta bu'i stong kyang las// de la ma lus sgrub par byed// 'di na mkhas 'ga' rnam shes las// ma gtogs ye shes mi 'dod cing*// stong nyid las gzhan don dam bden// mi bzhed pa la de ltar dris// stong nyid med dgag dkyil 'khor gyi// nye bar len pa'i rgyur mi rung*// rdzogs sangs rgyas blo rdzas gzhan zhig /rang dang 'brel med sgrub don ci// bh+rūm̐ dang hūm̐ sogs rang blo las// rdzas gzhan grub zin mi dgos// rang blo yin na de gang las// byung zhes khyed la dri bar bya// ye shes tshogs sog bsgom rjes su// med par dgag las gzhan med phyir// kho bo cag ni sgrub pa po// rang nyid chos dbyings ye shes kyi// ngo bor gyur las rten brten pa'i// dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par sgrub// 'di yi gnas tshul rgyu rgyud de// mos rlom ngo na 'bras bu'i rgyud// rang gi rgyu rgyud 'bras bur ni// zhen pa'i thabs kyis sgrub par byed// zhen blo goms pa mthar phyin tshe// gsal snang rtog med lhun grub pa// bskyed rim dngos yin mtha' gcig tu// rim de rtog par 'dod mi bya// sgrub pa'i thabs kyi dngos po ni// 'di na ngos 'dzin byed po 'ga'// bskyed pa'i rim pa las byung ba'i// yul can bde ba chen po yis// yul gyur stong nyid rtogs des bzhed// stong pa nyid kyi ngos 'dzin ni// dpal ldan zla ba'i rigs pa yis// gtan la phebs pa de las gzhan// dpal ldan 'dus par mi 'chad gsung*// zla bas mtshan nyid bstan bcos su// gang bshad sngags kyi lta bar ni// 'grig par dka' tshul zur du bkol// 'dir des rtogs tshul mtha' dpyad pa// 'dir des rtogs tshul tshad ma'am/

bcad pa'i shes pa gang yin dang*// gnyis snang tshul lam gnyis med du// rtogs sam rtogs blo kun rdzob kyi/ bden par 'dod dam de las gzhan// yin nam rtogs bya yang de bzhin// yul dang yul can dus mnyam mam// snga phyir byung zhes brtag par bya// tshad ma yin na pha rol du// phyin par gtan la ma phebs pa'i// lta ba gsang sngags la med ces// 'chad dang dngos su mi 'gal lam// dpyad shes yin na pha rol tu// phyin par yul can bde ba che// yul gyur stong nyid mngon sum du// rtogs blo yod par thal min nam// rtogs tshul gnyis snang du bzhed na// stong nyid rtogs blo'i mnyam gzhag ni// chu la chu gzhag ji bzhin par// bzhed dang dngos su mi 'gal lam// gnyis su med na bde ba che// nam mkha' lta bur thal ba'am// stong nyid med dgag ye shes kyi// bde chen dngos su thal bar 'gyur// bde chen ye shes kun rdzob tu// bden na bde chen ye shes de// kun rdzob bden pa sbyong byed du// 'chad dang dngos su 'gal min nam// bde chen ye shes don dam pa'i// bden par 'dod pa khyed cag gi /rtsa ba'i grub mtha' la med de// dngos kun brdzun phyir kun rdzob bden// rtogs bya stong nyid don dam du// bden pa las gzhan khyod mi 'dod// de ltar 'dod pa thal rang du// grags pa'i dbu ma nyid na med// kho bo cag ni gang du yang*// mi 'dod spros kun bral phyir ro// bla med sngags su bde stong gi /rtogs bya rtogs byed dus mnyam na// bde chen gang gis bskyed byed rgyu// de nyid stong nyid rtogs rgyur kyang*// thal bar 'gyur te khyed mi 'dod// snga phyir 'dod na sngon nyid nas// stong nyid rtogs blo bde chen gyi// dngos rgyu nyid du khas len nam// bzhi pa grub 'bras zung 'jug sku// kun rdzob bden nam bden pa gnyis// tha dad min par 'chad nus sam// khyed kyis mi 'chad gang gi phyir// rdzogs sangs rgyas sar kun rdzob kyi// bden pa'i mtshan gzhi khyed 'dod phyir// mi slob pa'i sar bden pa gnyis// so sor nges pa khyed kyi gzhung*// kun rdzob dang ni don dam dag

/gang du yang dag 'dres gyur pa// zung du 'jug par de bshad do// zhes pa klu sgrub zhabs kyi gzhung*// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// yang smras pa// bod du snga phyir byon pa yi// gsang ba 'dus pa 'chad po dag /rang la chags dang gzhan gzhung la// sdang bar byed pa mang mod kyi// rang gzhung rtsa ba tshugs pa dang*// gzhan gzhung rting phur 'jig nus pa'i// dgag sgrub brgal lan sbyor byed mkhan// gzhan 'ga' yod dam de ston cig/ //shu bhaṃ// // ༈ /rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum gyi lta ba'i rnam gzhag/ ༄༅// swasti/ klu sgrub zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas// slob dpon zla ba grags pa yis// rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum du bshad pa'i// stong nyid rtogs blo las lhag lta// sngags la med mod bde chen blos// de rtogs pa dang snying rje'i blos// de rtogs pa las theg gnyis kyi// thabs mkhas khyad par 'byed ces gsungs// 'jig rten mthun 'jug spangs nas ni// drang por smras 'di zla ba'i gzhung*// rnam gsum nyes blos ma sbags par// ltos la lung dang mthun nas dpyod// 'dir gsungs stong nyid spros pa'i mtha'// kun bral sngags kyi sgrub thabs su// sbyar du mi rung yon tan kun// rdzogs pa'i rten du mi rung phyir// de yi shes byed chos kun gyi// gnas tshul med par dgag pa las// gzhan med de yang yod ma yin// de 'dra'i don de brtag pa yi// mtha' ru bzung ste rtogs pa'i blo// rdzogs sangs rgyas la'ang yod min na// de rtogs byed po gzhan lta ci// lha bus zhus pa'i mdo dang ni// spyod 'jug mkhan pos de bshad phyir// phyis byon rang bzo mkhan rnams kyi// smra ba mang pos 'dir mi 'jigs// stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs blo// yod ma yin na spros pa'i mtha'// sel mkhas shes rab gang zhe na// de rtog byed po lung rigs kyi// thos bsam rtog pa las gzhan med// rtog pa de yang rang stong du// goms pas mnyam par bzhag pa na// med par dgag las gzhan mi srid// de las bzhengs pa'i rjes thob tu// bsod nams tshogs gsog byed mod kyi// de tshe snang cha rang stong du// bsam bya min zhes zla bas bshad// lha dang sngags sogs rang stong du// zhen par byas na bskyed rim 'gal// der ma zhen na thal 'gyur ba'i// stong nyid rtogs blo gang nas btsal// 'o na 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i// sbyin sogs ci la bya zhe na// gsum la zhen pas stong de la// byed par de rang nyid kyis bshad// bskyed rim la yang de lta bur// bshad pa nyid kyis chog ce na// zla grags bzhed pa'i stong pa nyid// mngon sum byas tshe stong nyid kyang*// snang ba med na yul gzhan gyi// snang bcas 'char ba lta ci smos// de na dngos gzhi blo med kyi// lta ba sngags la sbyar mi rung*// tshad mar gyur pa'i lung gzhan las// phung po rnam bcad stong pa nyid// chu shing snying po med 'dra bar// tshangs pa'i shing las pad+ma dang*// nim pa'i shing las rgu 'brum dang*// ha la'i 'dab ma 'chi med bcud// bskyed byed min pa'i dpes bstan pa// gangs can mkhas pa kun la grags// thal 'gyur bas bshad stong pa nyid// rtogs pa'i blo la dkyil 'khor gyi// rten dang brten pa kun shar ba'i// gzung rnam de nyid der goms pas// chos kyi sku dang gzugs kyi sku// lam byed tshang ba'i bskyed rim gyi// sgom pa phul du byung zhes 'chad// 'di la khyad gzhi mi 'thad cing*// khyad chos gzung rnam brtag par bya// thal 'gyur lugs kyi stong pa nyid// rtogs blo mngon sum mi srid cing*// zhen pa'i yul du gang byas pa// de nyid don dam par mi bden// ci phyir zhe na don dam pa// sgra rtog yul las 'das phyir dang*// rang mtshan min phyir mngon sum gyi// yul du mi rung mngon sum nyid// rang nyid rang gis mi stong na// rtogs bya'i stong nyid nyi tshe bar// song ngo de nyid des stong na// yul can mngon sum gang du btsal// chos kun yod ma myong ba dang*// tha snyad tsam gyi btags yod pa// gnyis po gang btsan dris pa na// khyed la phyi ma dbang btsan par// khas len dgos tshe ma rig pas// btags pa'i 'khrul snang dbang btsan 'gyur// kho bo cag ni btags pa'i don// 'tshol byed bdun gyis btsal ba na// rnyed ma myong phyir yod mi rung*// med pa'ang min te rten 'brel phyir// gnyis ka yin la ma ltos pa'i// gnyis min khas len mi rung ba// 'di de zla ba grags pa'i gzhung*// yin mod khyed kyis gzhan du bshad// chos kun tshang mas grub stengs su// dgag bya rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i// stong pa'i med par dgag pa tsam// rtogs blo'ang rjes dpag nyid las gzhan// tshad mar gyur pa'i blo med pa// 'di de dpal ldan zla ba yi// stong nyid rtogs tshul mtha' chod pa// yin par khyed 'dod de lta bu// sngags la sbyor tshul soms la smros// gzhan dbang kun btags kyis stong pa// de la sems tsam zhes zer na// gzhan dbang bden grub kyis stong pa// de yi ming 'dogs khyod la dkon// de nas gzung rnam la dpyad pa// de lta'i gzung rnam dkyil 'khor gyi// bsgrub gzhir 'dod ma yul can du// khas len snga ma ltar 'dod na// dkyil 'khor bsgrub gzhi sa bon dang*// cho ga gsum dang mngon byang las// bskyed par gsung mod stong nyid kyi// yul can mngon sum rjes dpag dang*// dpyad shes bsgrub gzhir bshad pa med// de de'i yul can du 'chad na// de lta'i gzung rnam rtog pa dang*// rtog med gnyis las 'das pa med// lhar zhen rtog pa lha nyid du// spang bar bya yi goms bya min// rtog pa med la log shes dang*// mngon sum nyid las gzhan mi srid// rnal 'byor mngon sum bskyed rim gyi// sgom la khyab pa ma yin no// thal 'gyur smra ba'i stong nyid kyi// yul can rtog pa las gzhan med// de tshe bde stong ji ltar sbyor// rtsa ba chad pa'i lo 'dab bzhin// bde ba che dang stong pa nyid// zung du 'jug par kun gyis 'chad// de'i dus kyi stong pa nyid// rnam par rtog pas stong tsam gyi// nyi tshe'i stong nyid la 'chad dam// rigs pa'i tshogs las gsungs pa yi// khyab pa'i stong pa nyid la 'chad// dang po ltar na thal 'gyur ba'i// stong pa nyid dang sbyor ba 'gal// phyi ma ltar na bde chen gyi// ye shes rang tshugs 'dzin mi nus// thal 'gyur lugs kyi stong pa nyid// khyed kyis ngos bzung byas pa 'di// bod kyi yul du dbu ma pa// sngon byon kun dang rta dbyangs kyis// sgyu ma rigs grub ces bya ba// dbu ma'i tha shal nyid du bshad// de las gong na mi gnas pa'i// dbu ma'i 'dod pa 'di lta ste// rang rgyud rjes su dpag pa yis// gang gzhal de yang yod min par// de yis dgag bya med pas grub// rmi lam bu ni ma shi ba// med pas shi ba yang med bzhin// gnas tshul bsam tshe khas len pa// ci yang med pa thal 'gyur dang*// rang rgyud smra ba mchog rnams kyi// bzhed yin bde stong ji ltar sbyor// bde ba chen pos rjes dpag gi

/gzhal bya dngos su 'jal byed na// bde chen rtog par mi thal lam// spros pa'i mtha' kun dang bral bar// 'jal na bde chen ye shes dang*// spros bral chu la chu bzhag par// song tshe yul dang yul can
